input.quote: The Company hereby grants to HDI a non-exclusive, limited, non-transferable license to use the Company's "Deerskin" trademarks, service
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data ownership provision. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (Sections 1.1-1.3) and the Company supplies all Content (Section 2.1) and is exposed to Company user information and data (Section 8.1), yet nothing states who owns the developed Site, the deliverables or the Company's Content and data, and there is no licence back of HDI IP embedded in the Site. The only grant is the trademark licence in Section 6.1, which is limited to carrying out HDI's obligations and does not cover ownership. Section 10.2's reference to "co-ownership" addresses the parties' relationship, not IP ownership. We therefore insert one short ownership section meeting the preferred position: Company ownership of the Site and deliverables with an assignment from HDI, HDI's retained background IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI IP, Company retention of all rights in Company Data with HDI's use limited to processing solely to provide the services, and no joint ownership.

ops.text: Ownership. The Company owns all right, title and interest in the Site and in all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, and HDI hereby assigns the same to the Company. HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in such deliverables. The Company retains all rights in all Content, user information and other data belonging to, supplied by, or collected or processed for the Company ("Company Data"), and any license to HDI in Company Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services under this Agreement. No intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the Parties.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on intellectual property, so we have added a short ownership section: we own the Site, deliverables and our Content and data, HDI keeps its pre-existing IP and grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to anything of its own embedded in the deliverables, HDI's use of our data is limited to providing the services, and nothing is jointly owned.
proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 5.5 establishing Company ownership of the Site, deliverables and Company Data, HDI's retained background IP with a licence back, and no joint ownership.
